subject: Avery Health: Confirming Q1 upsell timing and forecast hygiene
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Evan Liu <evan@averyhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@averyhealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Avery Health: Confirming Q1 upsell timing and forecast hygiene

Hi team,

Following our demo and the usage report attached (Avery_Eval_Usage_Q42026.pdf), Evan indicated Avery wants to expand to the Professional tier and add the private deployment option in Q1. Finance asked we tidy the forecast before the week closes so the commit numbers show up in the January run.

Quick ask: can CS confirm the likely contract start date window and a staged commit (best / likely / commit)? Finance needs one consolidated row for the Q1 forecast. Priyom, can you confirm which pipeline category we should map this to in HubSpot ("Commit", "Commit - Pending Legal", or "Upsell - Commit Watch")?

Proposed owner and next steps:
- Monica: confirm adoption signals and recommended go/no-go date for a firm commit (can be a 2-week window).
- Evan: confirm procurement timeline (any internal approval gates we should know about).
- Lauren: once Monica confirms, can you mark the forecast row and send the template back? I attached a working MAP (Avery_MAP_v1.xlsx).
- Priyom: update the HubSpot deal with the agreed commit tier and add this to next Wednesday's revenue cadence.

I can run a 15-min triage if that helps — open to a short call tomorrow.

Thanks,

Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Avery_Eval_Usage_Q42026.pdf, Avery_MAP_v1.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Evan Liu <evan@averyhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@averyhealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 13:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Avery Health: Confirming Q1 upsell timing and forecast hygiene

Thanks Ben — looping in a quick CS readout.

On Tue, Jan 12, 2027 at 9:12 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com> wrote:
> Following our demo and the usage report attached (Avery_Eval_Usage_Q42026.pdf), Evan indicated Avery wants to expand to the Professional tier and add the private deployment option in Q1.
>
> Quick ask: can CS confirm the likely contract start date window and a staged commit (best / likely / commit)? Finance needs one consolidated row for the Q1 forecast.

Evan — from our product adoption dashboard I see two healthy signals: 1) three power users (integrations and prompt libraries), 2) sustained token usage at ~20% above the POC baseline for 3 straight weeks. That maps well to Professional.

Proposed timing (internal recommendation):
- Best case: contract effective 2027-02-01 (procurement signs this week)
- Likely: contract effective 2027-02-15 (procurement & legal review)
- Commit: target effective 2027-03-01 if legal requires extra time

I can commit to firming this up by end of day Thursday after a short check with Evan and his procurement lead. Will add notes to the MAP and flag any open tech blockers.

Action items from CS:
- I will update Avery_MAP_v1.xlsx with adoption notes and recommended start date window.
- I will send a short adoption summary to Lauren for finance categorization.
- I am available for a 15-min sync tomorrow 10:30–10:45 PT if that suits folks.

— Monica
Monica Patel | Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 212-555-0178

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan@averyhealth.com>, procurement@averyhealth.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Avery Health: Confirming Q1 upsell timing and forecast hygiene

Thanks for the clarity — this is exactly the sort of staging we need to avoid surprises in the January close.

On Tue, Jan 12, 2027 at 1:04 PM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com> wrote:
> Evan — from our product adoption dashboard I see two healthy signals: 1) three power users (integrations and prompt libraries), 2) sustained token usage at ~20% above the POC baseline for 3 straight weeks. That maps well to Professional.
>
> Proposed timing (internal recommendation):
> - Best case: contract effective 2027-02-01 (procurement signs this week)
> - Likely: contract effective 2027-02-15 (procurement & legal review)
> - Commit: target effective 2027-03-01 if legal requires extra time

Couple notes from finance side: we only need a single "commit" row for the ledger, but it should reflect the most-likely close date. If Monica can confirm the "likely" date by Thursday EOD (2027-01-14), I'll move the amount into the Q1 commit bucket.

Please use the attached forecast_template.csv to return a single-line entry with: company, product, ARR delta, effective_date, contract_status. If legal expects a late signature, mark contract_status as "Commit - Pending Signature".

HubSpot link for the deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/rdw-3479 — Priyom, please make sure the deal stage is set to the bucket Lauren expects once we receive the row.

If we have the confirmed row by Thursday EOD I will include it in the Friday revenue close review. Otherwise, we'll keep it in the 'Upsell - Commit Watch' category.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop | Finance — Revenue Recognition | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0133

Attachment: forecast_template.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan@averyhealth.com>, procurement@averyhealth.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Avery Health: Confirming Q1 upsell timing and forecast hygiene

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick turn. Monica, appreciate the adoption notes and the 1-week confirmation commitment. Lauren, once we get the single-line CSV back I'll ping you and Priyom to update HubSpot and move the row to Commit.

Evan — thank you for flagging procurement. If you can send back the procurement contact's name and any PO timing, that will help Monica and Lauren finalize the dates. If it's helpful, I'm scheduling a 15-min triage for tomorrow 10:30 PT to walk through the MAP and finalize the CSV together (invite to follow).

Summary of immediate next steps:
- Evan/procurement: send procurement contact + expected PO window (this week or next).
- Monica: update Avery_MAP_v1.xlsx and confirm the "likely" effective date by Thursday EOD (2027-01-14).
- Lauren: expect single-line CSV and move to Q1 commit once received.
- Priyom: stand by to update HubSpot stage to Commit upon confirmation.

I'll follow up with the invite — thanks all.

Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments referenced: Avery_MAP_v1.xlsx, forecast_template.csv
